rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for the line around which a physical object spins.

example.english: This wheel spins around an axis.
example.traditional: 呢個輪係繞住條軸心轉嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 leon4 hai6 jiu5 zyu6 tiu4 zuk6 sam1 zyun2 ge3

rows.note: Use this specifically when the axis is the line of symmetry rather than a line of rotation.

example.english: This axis of symmetry divides the shape into two halves.
example.traditional: 呢條對稱軸將個圖形分成兩半。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 deoi3 cing3 zuk6 zoeng1 go3 tou4 jing4 fan1 sing4 loeng5 bun3

rows.note: Use this specifically for an axis used to position numbers or data on a graph.

example.english: This coordinate axis is used to represent time.
example.traditional: 呢條坐標軸係用嚟表示時間嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 co5 biu1 zuk6 hai6 jung6 lai4 biu2 si6 si4 gaan3 ge3
